title: Kelasi zamonning turli shakllari
goal_uz: Dars oxirida will, going to, Present Continuous va Present Simple ni ma’noga qarab tanlaysiz, Future Continuous va Future Perfect bilan kelajakdagi jarayon va natijani ifodalaysiz hamda vaqt ergash gaplarida will ishlatmasdan, o‘n yildan keyingi hayotingiz haqida kamida uchta shakl bilan gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Kelajak haqida gapiramiz
board: Lesson: Talking about the future
(Kelasi zamonning turli shakllari)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum, qadrli o‘quvchi! Oldingi darsda o‘tmishdagi davomli harakat bilan hikoya qilishni o‘rgandik: “I was walking home when it started to rain.” Bugun esa kelajakka o‘tamiz. Ingliz tilida kelajak bitta “will” bilan cheklanmaydi: reja, bashorat, kelishuv va jadval uchun turli shakllar bor. Dars oxirida o‘n yildan keyingi hayotingiz haqida kamida uchta kelasi zamon shaklini to‘g‘ri ishlatib gapira olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time we told stories about the past. Today we are looking ahead: plans, predictions, arrangements and timetables. By the end of this lesson, you will be able to choose the right future form for every situation.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar o‘tmish haqida hikoya qildik. Bugun oldinga qaraymiz: rejalar, bashoratlar, kelishuvlar va jadvallar. Dars oxirida har bir vaziyat uchun to‘g‘ri kelasi zamon shaklini tanlay olasiz.

scenes.title: Kelajakning oltita shakli
board: will + V · be going to + V
Present Continuous · Present Simple
will be + V-ing · will have + V3
scenes.say_native: Avval umumiy manzarani ko‘raylik. O‘zbek tilida “boraman” deymiz va u deyarli har qanday kelajakni bildiradi. Ingliz tilida esa tanlov ma’noga bog‘liq. “Will” — hozir qabul qilingan qaror yoki fikrga asoslangan bashorat. “Going to” — oldindan o‘ylab qo‘yilgan reja. Present Continuous — boshqalar bilan kelishilgan uchrashuv. Present Simple — jadval. Yana ikkita shakl bor: “will be doing” va “will have done”. Bugun hammasini birma-bir ko‘rib chiqamiz.
scenes.say: English has no single future tense. We choose a form according to our meaning: a quick decision, a plan, an arrangement, a timetable, an action in progress, or an action that will be finished.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilida yagona kelasi zamon yo‘q. Shaklni ma’noga qarab tanlaymiz: tezkor qaror, reja, kelishuv, jadval, davom etayotgan harakat yoki tugagan bo‘ladigan harakat.

scenes.title: Will: shu zahoti qaror
board: will / 'll + V1 (fe’lning asosiy shakli)
won't = will not
instant decisions · offers · promises

examples.t: I'll carry that bag for you.
Will you help me with this?

scenes.say_native: Birinchi shakl — “will”. U gapirayotgan paytda, shu zahoti qabul qilingan qarorni bildiradi. Xona sovuq bo‘ldi — “I’ll close the window.” Oldindan reja yo‘q edi, qaror hozir tug‘ildi. “Will” va’da, taklif va iltimos uchun ham ishlatiladi: “I’ll help you”, “I won’t be late”, “Will you open the door?” Esda tuting: “will” dan keyin fe’l doim asosiy shaklda, “to” siz keladi. Og‘zaki nutqda deyarli har doim qisqartiriladi: “I’ll”, “she’ll”, “we’ll”.
scenes.say: It's cold in here. I'll close the window. I'm hungry. I think I'll have a sandwich. Don't worry, I won't tell anyone. I promise.
scenes.say_uz: Bu yer sovuq ekan. Derazani yopaman. Qornim och. Menimcha, sendvich yeyman. Xavotir olmang, hech kimga aytmayman. Va’da beraman.

scenes.title: Shall I...? Shall we...?
board: Shall I + V? (taklif: ...ymi?)
Shall we + V? (taklif: ...aylikmi?)
AmE: Should I...? / Do you want me to...?
scenes.say_native: Taklif qilganda britaniyaliklar “I” va “we” bilan savolda “shall” ishlatadi. “Shall I open the window?” — derazani ochaymi? “Shall we go?” — boraylikmi? Bu o‘zbekchadagi “-aymi”, “-aylikmi” qo‘shimchalariga juda o‘xshaydi, shuning uchun eslab qolish oson. Amerika ingliz tilida “shall” kamroq ishlatiladi, uning o‘rniga “Should I...?” yoki “Do you want me to...?” deyishadi. Darak gapda “I shall” juda rasmiy va eskicha eshitiladi, kundalik nutqda “I’ll” deng.
scenes.say: Shall I open the window? Shall we go for a walk after lunch? What shall we do this evening?
scenes.say_uz: Derazani ochaymi? Tushlikdan keyin sayr qilaylikmi? Bugun kechqurun nima qilamiz?

scenes.title: Be going to: oldindan reja
board: am / is / are + going to + V1
plan or intention (oldindan qaror)
I'm going to study medicine.

examples.t: We're going to paint the kitchen this weekend.
examples.uz: Shu dam olish kunlari oshxonani bo‘yamoqchimiz.

examples.t: She isn't going to apply for that job.
examples.uz: U o‘sha ishga ariza bermoqchi emas.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi shakl — “be going to”. U gapirishdan oldin qabul qilingan qaror, ya’ni niyat va rejani bildiradi. “I’m going to study medicine” — bu fikr hozir tug‘ilmagan, men buni ancha oldin hal qilganman. Tuzilishi: “am, is, are” plus “going to” plus fe’lning asosiy shakli. O‘zbekchada bunga eng yaqin shakl — “-moqchiman”: “o‘qimoqchiman”, “sotmoqchi”. Inkor va so‘roq “be” fe’li orqali yasaladi: “I’m not going to”, “Are you going to...?”
scenes.say: I'm going to study medicine at university. My parents are going to sell their old car. Are you going to watch the match tonight? No, I'm not going to watch it.
scenes.say_uz: Universitetda tibbiyot o‘qimoqchiman. Ota-onam eski mashinasini sotmoqchi. Bugun kechqurun o‘yinni ko‘rmoqchimisiz? Yo‘q, ko‘rmoqchi emasman.

scenes.title: Going to: ko‘z oldidagi dalil
board: prediction + present evidence
Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
Careful! You're going to fall!
scenes.say_native: “Going to” ning ikkinchi vazifasi — hozir ko‘z oldimizdagi dalilga asoslangan bashorat. Osmonda qora bulutlarni ko‘ryapsiz — “It’s going to rain.” Stakan stol chetida turibdi — “It’s going to fall.” Bu yerda reja yo‘q, lekin hozirgi vaziyat kelajakni aniq ko‘rsatib turibdi. O‘zbekchada bunday paytda oddiy “yog‘adi” yoki “yiqiladi” deymiz, shuning uchun ingliz tilida “will” ishlatib yuborish oson. Dalil ko‘z oldingizda bo‘lsa, “going to” ni tanlang.
scenes.say: Look at those dark clouds. It's going to rain. Careful! That glass is going to fall off the table! The score is four nil with five minutes left. They're going to win.
scenes.say_uz: Anavi qora bulutlarga qarang. Yomg‘ir yog‘adi. Ehtiyot bo‘ling! Anavi stakan stoldan tushib ketadi! Hisob to‘rt-nol, besh daqiqa qoldi. Ular yutadi.

scenes.title: Will va going to yonma-yon
board: The phone's ringing. → I'll get it. (hozir qaror)
I'm going to call Mum tonight. (oldindan reja)
scenes.say_native: Ikkita mini-vaziyatni solishtiring. Birinchisida sut tugaganini B hozir eshitdi va shu zahoti qaror qildi: “I’ll buy some.” Ikkinchisida B krossovkasini allaqachon kiyib olgan, demak qaror oldin qabul qilingan: “I’m going to go for a run.” Asosiy savol: qaror qachon qabul qilingan? Gapirish paytida bo‘lsa — “will”. Gapirishdan oldin bo‘lsa — “going to”. Bu farqni sezish uchun har doim vaziyatga qarang.
scenes.say: A: We've run out of milk. B: Oh, really? I'll buy some on my way home. ... A: Why are you wearing your trainers? B: I'm going to go for a run.
scenes.say_uz: A: Sutimiz tugab qolibdi. B: Rostdanmi? Uyga ketayotib olib kelaman. ... A: Nega krossovka kiyib olding? B: Yugurgani chiqmoqchiman.

scenes.title: Will dan keyin to yo‘q
board: ✗ I will to call you.  ✓ I'll call you.
✗ I will going to the bank.  ✓ I'm going to go to the bank.
✗ She going to buy a car.  ✓ She's going to buy a car.
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi: “will” dan keyin “to” qo‘yish. “Will” modal fe’l, undan keyin “to” kelmaydi: “I’ll call you.” Ikkinchisi: ikki shaklni aralashtirish, masalan “I will going”. Shakllarning har biri alohida, ularni qo‘shib bo‘lmaydi. Uchinchisi: “going to” dan oldin “be” ni tushirib qoldirish. “She going to buy” emas, “She’s going to buy.” O‘zbekchada bog‘lovchi fe’l yo‘qligi sababli “is” ko‘pincha unutiladi, bunga alohida e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: I'll call you later. I'm going to go to the bank. She's going to buy a new car.
scenes.say_uz: Sizga keyinroq qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Bankka bormoqchiman. U yangi mashina sotib olmoqchi.

scenes.title: Will yoki going to?
board: 1) I've decided. I ___ learn to drive this year.
2) A: I've got a headache. B: Wait, I ___ get you some water.
3) Look at that man on the ladder! He ___ fall.
4) A: Tea or coffee? B: I ___ have tea, please.
scenes.say_native: Navbat sizga. Ekrandagi to‘rtta gapni to‘ldiring: “will” yoki “going to”? Har birida o‘zingizdan so‘rang: qaror hozir qabul qilindimi yoki oldinmi? Ko‘z oldida dalil bormi? Pauza paytida javoblarni baland ovozda ayting, keyin tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: One: I've decided. I ... learn to drive this year. Two: I've got a headache. Wait, I ... get you some water. Three: Look at that man on the ladder! He ... fall. Four: Tea or coffee? I ... have tea, please.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: qaror qildim, bu yil haydashni o‘rganaman. Ikki: boshim og‘riyapti. Kuting, sizga suv olib kelaman. Uch: narvondagi odamga qarang! Yiqiladi. To‘rt: choymi yoki qahva? Choy ichaman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I'm going to learn (qaror oldin)
2) I'll get (hozir qaror, taklif)
3) He's going to fall (dalil)
4) I'll have (hozir tanlov)
scenes.say_native: Tekshiramiz. Birinchisida “I’ve decided” — qaror allaqachon qabul qilingan, shuning uchun “I’m going to learn.” Ikkinchisida yordam berish fikri shu zahoti tug‘ildi va bu taklif: “I’ll get you some water.” Uchinchisida odam narvonda chayqalib turibdi, bu ko‘z oldidagi dalil: “He’s going to fall.” To‘rtinchisida mehmonxonada yoki kafeda tanlov hozir qilinyapti: “I’ll have tea.” To‘rttasini ham topgan bo‘lsangiz, ajoyib!
scenes.say: One: I'm going to learn to drive. Two: I'll get you some water. Three: He's going to fall. Four: I'll have tea, please.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: haydashni o‘rganmoqchiman. Ikki: sizga suv olib kelaman. Uch: u yiqiladi. To‘rt: choy ichaman, iltimos.

scenes.title: Present Continuous: kelishuvlar
board: am / is / are + V-ing + future time
fixed arrangement (kelishilgan, belgilangan)
I'm meeting Aziz at six tomorrow.

examples.t: She's flying to Istanbul on Friday.
I'm seeing the dentist at ten.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi shakl sizni ajablantirishi mumkin: Present Continuous ham kelajakni bildiradi. U boshqa odamlar bilan kelishilgan, vaqti va joyi belgilangan uchrashuv yoki tadbir uchun ishlatiladi. “I’m meeting Aziz at six tomorrow” — biz allaqachon kelishib qo‘yganmiz. Bunday gaplarda odatda vaqt ko‘rsatkichi bo‘ladi: “tomorrow”, “on Sunday”, “next week”. Aks holda tinglovchi gapni hozirgi harakat deb tushunishi mumkin. Kundalik nutqda shaxsiy rejalar haqida aynan shu shakl eng ko‘p eshitiladi.
scenes.say: I'm meeting Aziz at six tomorrow. We're having dinner at my parents' house on Sunday. What are you doing on Saturday evening?
scenes.say_uz: Ertaga soat oltida Aziz bilan uchrashaman. Yakshanba kuni ota-onamnikida kechki ovqat qilamiz. Shanba kuni kechqurun nima qilyapsiz?

scenes.title: Reja va kelishuv farqi
board: going to = intention (niyat, faqat mening boshimda)
Present Continuous = arrangement (kelishilgan, chipta bor)
I'm going to visit Rome one day. / I'm flying to Rome on Monday.
scenes.say_native: “Going to” bilan Present Continuous ko‘pincha bir-birining o‘rnida keladi, lekin nozik farq bor. “Going to” — niyat, u hozircha faqat boshimda. “I’m going to visit Rome one day” — chipta yo‘q, sana yo‘q. Present Continuous esa amalga oshirish uchun aniq qadamlar qo‘yilganini ko‘rsatadi: chipta olingan, stol band qilingan, odam bilan kelishilgan. Agar ishonchingiz komil bo‘lmasa, “going to” deyarli har doim to‘g‘ri bo‘ladi, lekin kelishuvlarda Present Continuous tabiiyroq eshitiladi.
scenes.say: I'm going to visit Rome one day. I haven't booked anything yet. But my brother is flying to Rome on Monday. He's got his ticket and his hotel.
scenes.say_uz: Bir kun Rimga bormoqchiman. Hali hech narsa band qilmadim. Lekin akam dushanba kuni Rimga uchadi. Uning chiptasi ham, mehmonxonasi ham bor.

scenes.title: Present Simple: jadval va dastur
board: timetables, schedules, programmes
The train leaves at 7.15.
The course starts on 3 March.

examples.t: The shop opens at nine on Saturdays.
examples.uz: Do‘kon shanba kunlari soat to‘qqizda ochiladi.

examples.t: The exam begins at 10 a.m. on Monday.
examples.uz: Imtihon dushanba kuni ertalab soat o‘nda boshlanadi.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi shakl — Present Simple. U jadval, dastur va rasmiy taqvim bo‘yicha bo‘ladigan voqealar uchun ishlatiladi: poyezd, samolyot, kino, dars, kurs. “The train leaves at 7.15” — bu shaxsiy qaror emas, rasmiy jadval. Bunday fe’llar odatda “leave”, “start”, “arrive”, “open”, “close”, “begin”, “finish”. Diqqat: shaxsiy rejalar uchun Present Simple ishlatilmaydi. “I go to Paris tomorrow” deb bo‘lmaydi, bu yerda “I’m going to Paris tomorrow” kerak.
scenes.say: The train to Samarkand leaves at seven fifteen tomorrow morning. The film starts at eight, so don't be late. What time does your flight arrive?
scenes.say_uz: Samarqandga poyezd ertaga ertalab yettidan o‘n besh daqiqa o‘tganda jo‘naydi. Kino soat sakkizda boshlanadi, kechikmang. Reysingiz soat nechada qo‘nadi?

scenes.title: Shaxsiy reja uchun Present Simple emas
board: ✗ I meet Aziz tomorrow.  ✓ I'm meeting Aziz tomorrow.
✗ What do you do tonight?  ✓ What are you doing tonight?
✓ The bus leaves at 6. (jadval)
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida so‘zlovchilarning eng ko‘p xatosi shu yerda. O‘zbekchada “ertaga Aziz bilan uchrashaman” deymiz va fe’l hozirgi-kelasi zamonda turadi. Shuni to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri ko‘chirsak, “I meet Aziz tomorrow” chiqadi, bu xato. Shaxsiy kelishuv uchun Present Continuous kerak. Ayniqsa “What do you do tonight?” savoli xato: “What do you do?” kasbni so‘raydi. Bugungi kechqurun haqida “What are you doing tonight?” deb so‘rang.
scenes.say: I'm meeting Aziz tomorrow. What are you doing tonight? The bus leaves at six.
scenes.say_uz: Ertaga Aziz bilan uchrashaman. Bugun kechqurun nima qilyapsiz? Avtobus soat oltida jo‘naydi.

scenes.title: Qaysi shakl?
board: 1) The concert ___ (start) at 7.30.
2) I ___ (have) lunch with my boss tomorrow. We booked a table.
3) One day I ___ (write) a book.
4) Hurry up! The museum ___ (close) in twenty minutes.
scenes.say_native: Endi uchta shaklni ajratamiz: jadval uchun Present Simple, kelishuv uchun Present Continuous, niyat uchun “going to”. Qavsdagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri shaklga qo‘ying. Har bir gapda kalit so‘zni qidiring: “we booked a table” — kelishuv belgisi, “one day” — hali aniq emas, muzey vaqti — rasmiy jadval.
scenes.say: One: The concert ... start at seven thirty. Two: I ... have lunch with my boss tomorrow. We booked a table. Three: One day I ... write a book. Four: Hurry up! The museum ... close in twenty minutes.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: konsert yettiyu o‘ttizda boshlanadi. Ikki: ertaga boshlig‘im bilan tushlik qilaman, stol band qildik. Uch: bir kun kitob yozmoqchiman. To‘rt: tezroq! Muzey yigirma daqiqadan keyin yopiladi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) starts (jadval)
2) I'm having (kelishuv)
3) I'm going to write (niyat)
4) closes (jadval)
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi va to‘rtinchi gaplarda rasmiy vaqt jadvali bor, shuning uchun “starts” va “closes”. Uchinchi shaxs birlikdagi “-s” qo‘shimchasini unutmang. Ikkinchi gapda stol band qilingan, bu kelishuv: “I’m having lunch.” Uchinchi gapda “one day” — aniq sana yo‘q, faqat niyat bor: “I’m going to write a book.” Bu yerda “I’m writing a book” desangiz, hozir yozayapman degan ma’no chiqadi.
scenes.say: One: The concert starts at seven thirty. Two: I'm having lunch with my boss tomorrow. Three: One day I'm going to write a book. Four: The museum closes in twenty minutes.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: konsert yettiyu o‘ttizda boshlanadi. Ikki: ertaga boshlig‘im bilan tushlik qilaman. Uch: bir kun kitob yozmoqchiman. To‘rt: muzey yigirma daqiqadan keyin yopiladi.

scenes.title: Bashoratlar: will yoki going to
board: opinion → will: I think / I'm sure / probably
evidence → going to: Look!
I think it'll be a great year. / Look, it's going to snow.
scenes.say_native: Endi bashoratlarni chuqurroq ko‘ramiz. Fikr, ishonch yoki taxminga asoslangan bashorat uchun “will” ishlatamiz. U ko‘pincha “I think”, “I’m sure”, “I expect”, “probably”, “definitely” bilan keladi. “I think prices will go up” — bu mening fikrim, ko‘z oldimda dalil yo‘q. Hozirgi aniq belgiga asoslanganda esa “going to”. Ob-havo ma’lumoti, sport sharhi yoki iqtisodiy prognozda ikkalasini ham eshitasiz, lekin farq doim bir xil: fikr yoki dalil.
scenes.say: I think prices will go up next year. I'm sure you'll pass your exam. In fifty years, people will probably live longer. But look at the sky. It's going to snow.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, keyingi yil narxlar oshadi. Imtihondan o‘tishingizga aminman. Ellik yildan keyin odamlar ehtimol uzoqroq yashaydi. Lekin osmonga qarang. Qor yog‘adi.

scenes.title: Probably va definitely ning o‘rni
board: He'll probably be late.
He probably won't come.
I'll definitely call you. / I definitely won't forget.
scenes.say_native: “Probably” va “definitely” so‘zlarining gapdagi o‘rni muhim. Darak gapda ular “will” dan keyin keladi: “She’ll probably be late”, “I’ll definitely call.” Inkor gapda esa “won’t” dan oldin keladi: “He probably won’t come”, “I definitely won’t forget.” O‘zbekchada “ehtimol” va “albatta” so‘zlari gapning deyarli istalgan joyida turishi mumkin, ingliz tilida esa joyi qat’iy. Bu kichik qoida nutqingizni ancha tabiiy qiladi.
scenes.say: She'll probably be late again. He probably won't come to the party. I'll definitely call you tomorrow. Don't worry, I definitely won't forget.
scenes.say_uz: U ehtimol yana kechikadi. U ehtimol ziyofatga kelmaydi. Ertaga sizga albatta qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Xavotir olmang, albatta unutmayman.

scenes.title: Probably noto‘g‘ri joyda
board: ✗ He will not probably come.  ✓ He probably won't come.
✗ Probably she will late.  ✓ She'll probably be late.
✗ I think it won't rain.  ✓ I don't think it'll rain.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xatoga qarang. Birinchisi: “will not probably” — inkorda “probably” “won’t” dan oldin keladi. Ikkinchisi: “She will late” — sifatdan oldin “be” kerak: “She’ll be late.” Uchinchisi nozikroq: o‘zbekchada “menimcha, yomg‘ir yog‘maydi” deymiz, ingliz tilida esa inkorni “think” ga o‘tkazish tabiiyroq: “I don’t think it’ll rain.” “I think it won’t rain” grammatik jihatdan mumkin, lekin kamroq eshitiladi.
scenes.say: He probably won't come. She'll probably be late. I don't think it'll rain.
scenes.say_uz: U ehtimol kelmaydi. U ehtimol kechikadi. Menimcha, yomg‘ir yog‘maydi.

scenes.title: Bashorat qiling
board: 1) The traffic is terrible. We ___ miss the plane!
2) I think robots ___ do most housework in the future.
3) She's studied hard. She ___ definitely pass.
4) (not / think) It ___ be cold tomorrow.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta bashorat. Har birida o‘ylang: bu fikrmi yoki ko‘z oldidagi dalilmi? To‘rtinchi gapda “not” va “think” so‘zlaridan foydalanib, inkorni to‘g‘ri joyga qo‘yib, butun gapni tuzing. Uchinchi gapda “definitely” qayerda turishini ham unutmang.
scenes.say: One: The traffic is terrible. We ... miss the plane! Two: I think robots ... do most housework in the future. Three: She's studied hard. She ... definitely pass. Four: I don't think it ... be cold tomorrow.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: tirbandlik dahshat. Samolyotga ulgurmaymiz! Ikki: menimcha, kelajakda uy ishlarining ko‘pini robotlar qiladi. Uch: u yaxshi tayyorlandi. Albatta o‘tadi. To‘rt: menimcha, ertaga sovuq bo‘lmaydi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) We're going to miss (dalil: tirbandlik)
2) robots will do (fikr: I think)
3) She'll definitely pass
4) I don't think it'll be cold tomorrow.
scenes.say_native: Tekshiramiz. Birinchi gapda tirbandlik ko‘z oldimizda, shuning uchun “We’re going to miss the plane.” Ikkinchisida “I think” bor, bu fikr: “robots will do.” Uchinchisida darak gap, demak “definitely” “will” dan keyin: “She’ll definitely pass.” To‘rtinchisida inkor “think” ga o‘tdi: “I don’t think it’ll be cold.” Agar “It will not be cold, I think” desangiz ham tushunishadi, lekin bu ancha g‘ayritabiiy eshitiladi.
scenes.say: One: We're going to miss the plane. Two: I think robots will do most housework. Three: She'll definitely pass. Four: I don't think it'll be cold tomorrow.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: samolyotga ulgurmaymiz. Ikki: menimcha, uy ishlarining ko‘pini robotlar qiladi. Uch: u albatta o‘tadi. To‘rt: menimcha, ertaga sovuq bo‘lmaydi.

scenes.title: Future Continuous
board: will be + V-ing
action in progress at a future moment
This time tomorrow I'll be flying to London.

examples.t: At noon tomorrow, I'll be sitting in an exam.
Next summer we'll be living in Tashkent.

scenes.say_native: Endi ikkinchi asosiy mavzu. Future Continuous: “will be” plus fe’lning “-ing” shakli. U kelajakdagi ma’lum bir paytda davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi. Oldingi darsdagi Past Continuous ni eslang: “At eight I was watching TV.” Endi xuddi shu tasvirni kelajakka ko‘chiramiz: “At eight I’ll be watching TV.” Ya’ni o‘sha payt kelganda harakat allaqachon boshlangan va hali tugamagan bo‘ladi. Bunday gaplarda ko‘pincha “this time tomorrow”, “at six o’clock”, “all evening” kabi iboralar bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to London. At eight o'clock tonight we'll be watching the final. Don't call me between two and four. I'll be working.
scenes.say_uz: Ertaga shu vaqtda Londonga uchib ketayotgan bo‘laman. Bugun kechqurun soat sakkizda finalni tomosha qilayotgan bo‘lamiz. Soat ikkidan to‘rtgacha qo‘ng‘iroq qilmang. Ishlayotgan bo‘laman.

scenes.title: Muloyim so‘roq: Will you be...?
board: Will you be using the car tonight?
Will you be coming to the meeting?
(muloyim, bosimsiz savol)
scenes.say_native: Future Continuous ning juda foydali, lekin kam o‘rgatiladigan vazifasi bor: muloyim so‘roq. “Will you use the car tonight?” biroz iltimos yoki talabga o‘xshaydi. “Will you be using the car tonight?” esa shunchaki rejalaringiz haqida xushmuomalalik bilan so‘raydi. Shuningdek, “I’ll be passing the post office anyway” — baribir o‘sha tomondan o‘taman, ya’ni bu odatiy ish jarayonining bir qismi. Ishxonada va mehmonxonada bunday savollarni ko‘p eshitasiz.
scenes.say: Will you be using the car tonight? If not, can I borrow it? ... Will you be joining us for dinner on Friday? ... I'll be passing the post office anyway, so I can post your letter.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun kechqurun mashinadan foydalanasizmi? Agar yo‘q bo‘lsa, olib tursam bo‘ladimi? ... Juma kuni kechki ovqatga qo‘shilasizmi? ... Baribir pochta yonidan o‘taman, xatingizni jo‘natib qo‘yaman.

scenes.title: Future Perfect
board: will have + V3 (past participle)
finished before a future time
By 2030 I'll have graduated.

examples.t: By Friday, they'll have built the bridge.
examples.uz: Jumagacha ular ko‘prikni qurib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

examples.t: By the time you arrive, we'll have eaten.
examples.uz: Siz kelguningizcha biz ovqatlanib bo‘lgan bo‘lamiz.

scenes.say_native: Future Perfect: “will have” plus fe’lning uchinchi shakli. U kelajakdagi ma’lum paytdan oldin tugagan bo‘ladigan harakatni bildiradi. Kelajakka borib, orqaga qaraymiz: soat to‘qqiz bo‘lganda kechki ovqat allaqachon tugagan bo‘ladi. O‘zbek tilida bunga ajoyib mos shakl bor: “tugatgan bo‘laman”, “tamomlagan bo‘laman”. Noto‘g‘ri fe’llarning uchinchi shaklini eslang: “read — read — read”, “write — wrote — written”, “go — went — gone”.
scenes.say: By the end of this month, I'll have read five books. By 2030, I'll have graduated from university. Call me at nine. I'll have finished dinner by then.
scenes.say_uz: Shu oy oxirigacha beshta kitob o‘qib bo‘lgan bo‘laman. 2030-yilgacha universitetni tamomlagan bo‘laman. Soat to‘qqizda qo‘ng‘iroq qiling. Ungacha kechki ovqatni tugatgan bo‘laman.

scenes.title: Ikki shaklni solishtiramiz
board: At 6: I'll be cooking. (jarayonda)
By 6: I'll have cooked dinner. (tugagan)
at = o‘sha paytda · by = o‘sha paytgacha
scenes.say_native: Ikkala shaklni bitta vaqt chizig‘ida tasavvur qiling. Soat oltida men oshxonada turibman, ish jarayonda: “I’ll be cooking.” Soat yettiga kelib ish tugagan: “I’ll have cooked.” Kalit so‘zlarga e’tibor bering: “at six” — aynan o‘sha paytda, demak ko‘pincha Future Continuous. “By seven” — o‘sha paytgacha, kechi bilan o‘sha paytda, demak ko‘pincha Future Perfect. O‘zbekchada ham farq aniq: “pishirayotgan bo‘laman” va “pishirib bo‘lgan bo‘laman”.
scenes.say: At six o'clock I'll be cooking dinner, so the kitchen will smell wonderful. By seven o'clock I'll have cooked everything, and we'll be eating.
scenes.say_uz: Soat oltida kechki ovqat pishirayotgan bo‘laman, shuning uchun oshxonadan ajoyib hid keladi. Soat yettigacha hammasini pishirib bo‘lgan bo‘laman va biz ovqatlanayotgan bo‘lamiz.

scenes.title: By va until ni aralashtirmang
board: ✗ I'll have finished it until Friday.
✓ I'll have finished it by Friday. (juma kuni yoki undan oldin)
✓ I'll be here until Friday. (juma kunigacha davomli)
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekchadagi “-gacha” qo‘shimchasi ingliz tilida ikki xil so‘zga bo‘linadi. “By” — eng kechi bilan o‘sha paytda, harakat o‘sha paytgacha bir marta tugaydi: “by Friday”. “Until” esa harakat o‘sha paytgacha uzluksiz davom etishini bildiradi: “I’ll be here until six.” Shuning uchun Future Perfect deyarli har doim “by” bilan keladi. Yana bir xato: “will have finish” — uchinchi shakl kerak: “will have finished”. Rus tilida gapiradiganlar uchun ham bu tuzoq: “к пятнице” — “by”, “до пятницы” esa ko‘pincha “until”.
scenes.say: I'll have finished the report by Friday. I'll be in the office until six.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobotni jumagacha tugatib qo‘ygan bo‘laman. Soat oltigacha ofisda bo‘laman.

scenes.title: Davomli yoki tugagan?
board: 1) This time next week I ___ (lie) on a beach.
2) By the end of the year, she ___ (save) $1,000.
3) Don't phone at 9. We ___ (have) dinner.
4) I'll have done it ___ Monday. (by / until)
scenes.say_native: Har bir gapda o‘zingizdan so‘rang: o‘sha paytda harakat davom etayotgan bo‘ladimi yoki allaqachon tugagan bo‘ladimi? Davom etsa “will be” plus “-ing”, tugagan bo‘lsa “will have” plus uchinchi shakl. To‘rtinchi gapda esa ikki so‘zdan birini tanlang. Pauzada to‘liq gapni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: One: This time next week I ... lie on a beach. Two: By the end of the year, she ... save a thousand dollars. Three: Don't phone at nine. We ... have dinner. Four: I'll have done it ... Monday. By or until?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: kelasi hafta shu vaqtda plyajda yotgan bo‘laman. Ikki: yil oxirigacha u ming dollar yig‘ib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi. Uch: soat to‘qqizda qo‘ng‘iroq qilmang. Kechki ovqat qilayotgan bo‘lamiz. To‘rt: dushanbagacha qilib qo‘ygan bo‘laman. By yoki until?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I'll be lying
2) she'll have saved
3) We'll be having
4) by Monday
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi gapda “this time next week” — o‘sha paytdagi jarayon: “I’ll be lying.” “Lie” fe’lining “-ing” shakli “lying” deb yoziladi, “ie” “y” ga aylanadi. Ikkinchisida “by the end of the year” — natija: “she’ll have saved.” Uchinchisida soat to‘qqizdagi jarayon: “We’ll be having dinner.” To‘rtinchisida bir martalik natija, demak “by Monday”. Ikkala shakl ham og‘zaki nutqda qisqaradi: “I’ll be”, “she’ll have”.
scenes.say: One: This time next week I'll be lying on a beach. Two: By the end of the year, she'll have saved a thousand dollars. Three: We'll be having dinner. Four: I'll have done it by Monday.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: kelasi hafta shu vaqtda plyajda yotgan bo‘laman. Ikki: yil oxirigacha u ming dollar yig‘ib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi. Uch: kechki ovqat qilayotgan bo‘lamiz. To‘rt: dushanbagacha qilib qo‘ygan bo‘laman.

scenes.title: Vaqt ergash gaplari
board: when / as soon as / before / after / until / once
+ Present Simple (NOT will)
When I get home, I'll call you.
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi katta mavzu — kelajak haqidagi vaqt ergash gaplari. Muhim qoida: “when”, “as soon as”, “before”, “after”, “until”, “once”, “by the time” so‘zlaridan keyin, garchi ma’no kelajak bo‘lsa ham, “will” ishlatilmaydi. Ergash gapda Present Simple keladi, “will” esa faqat bosh gapda bo‘ladi. “When I get home, I’ll call you.” Ergash gap birinchi kelsa, undan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi. Bosh gap birinchi kelsa, vergul shart emas: “I’ll call you when I get home.”
scenes.say: When I get home, I'll call you. As soon as the rain stops, we'll go out. I'll wait here until you come back. Before you leave, please turn off the lights.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga yetganimda sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Yomg‘ir to‘xtashi bilan tashqariga chiqamiz. Siz qaytib kelguningizcha shu yerda kutaman. Ketishdan oldin chiroqlarni o‘chiring.

scenes.title: Present Perfect vaqt gaplarida
board: when / after / as soon as + have done
(harakat tugaganiga urg‘u)
I'll lend you the book when I've finished it.
scenes.say_native: Vaqt ergash gapida Present Perfect ham kelishi mumkin. U birinchi harakat to‘liq tugaganidan keyingina ikkinchisi boshlanishini ta’kidlaydi. “I’ll lend you the book when I’ve finished it” — avval kitobni oxirigacha o‘qiyman, keyin beraman. Ko‘p hollarda ikkala variant ham to‘g‘ri: “after you do” va “after you’ve done”. Lekin ikkalasida ham “will” yo‘q. Esingizda bo‘lsin: bu yerda ham kelajak ma’nosi bor, lekin grammatik shakl hozirgi zamonda.
scenes.say: I'll lend you the book when I've finished it. You can go out after you've done your homework. As soon as I've saved enough money, I'll buy a laptop.
scenes.say_uz: Kitobni o‘qib bo‘lganimdan keyin sizga beraman. Uy vazifangizni qilib bo‘lganingizdan keyin tashqariga chiqishingiz mumkin. Yetarlicha pul yig‘ishim bilan noutbuk sotib olaman.

scenes.title: O‘zbek va rus tili bilan solishtirish
board: Uyga kelganimda... / kelishim bilan... / kelguningizcha...
Когда я приду, я позвоню. (rus: kelasi zamon)
When I come, I'll call. (ingliz: hozirgi zamon)
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida bu vaziyatda sifatdosh va ravishdosh shakllar ishlatiladi: “kelganimda”, “kelishim bilan”, “kelguningizcha”. Ularda “-aman” kabi kelasi zamon qo‘shimchasi yo‘q, shuning uchun o‘zbek tilida so‘zlovchilar uchun bu qoida unchalik qiyin emas. Rus tilini yaxshi biladiganlar esa ehtiyot bo‘lsin: ruschada “Когда я приду, я позвоню” deyiladi, ya’ni ikkala qismda ham kelasi zamon. Ingliz tilida esa “when” dan keyin kelasi zamon qo‘yilmaydi.
scenes.say: When I come home, I'll call you. As soon as I find a job, I'll rent a flat. Until you finish, nobody will leave the room.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga kelganimda sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Ish topishim bilan kvartira ijaraga olaman. Siz tugatmaguningizcha hech kim xonadan chiqmaydi.

scenes.title: When dan keyin will qo‘ymang
board: ✗ When I will arrive, I'll text you.
✓ When I arrive, I'll text you.
✓ When will you arrive? (bu savol — will mumkin)
scenes.say_native: Eng tipik xato: “When I will arrive, I’ll text you.” Ergash gapdagi “will” ni olib tashlang: “When I arrive.” Lekin bir nozik jihat bor. Agar “when” savol so‘zi bo‘lsa, ya’ni qachon deb so‘rasangiz, “will” bemalol ishlatiladi: “When will you arrive?” Shuningdek, “I don’t know when he’ll come” ham to‘g‘ri, chunki bu yerda “when” vaqt ergash gapini emas, “qachon” degan savolni bildiradi. Qoida faqat “...ganda, ...gach” ma’nosidagi “when” uchun.
scenes.say: When I arrive, I'll text you. But in a question: When will you arrive?
scenes.say_uz: Yetib kelganimda sizga xabar yozaman. Lekin savolda: qachon yetib kelasiz?

scenes.title: Xatoni toping
board: 1) I'll call you as soon as I will land.
2) Before you will go, close the door.
3) We'll stay inside until the storm will stop.
4) When will the next bus come?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Ulardan uchtasida xato bor, bittasi to‘g‘ri. Qaysi biri to‘g‘ri ekanini toping va qolganlarini tuzating. Maslahat: “when”, “as soon as”, “before”, “until” so‘zlari vaqt ergash gapini boshlayaptimi yoki savol berayaptimi, shunga qarang.
scenes.say: One: I'll call you as soon as I will land. Two: Before you will go, close the door. Three: We'll stay inside until the storm will stop. Four: When will the next bus come?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: qo‘nishim bilan sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Ikki: ketishdan oldin eshikni yoping. Uch: bo‘ron to‘xtaguncha ichkarida qolamiz. To‘rt: keyingi avtobus qachon keladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) as soon as I land
2) Before you go
3) until the storm stops
4) ✓ correct (savol)
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi uchta gapda “will” ergash gapda turibdi, uni olib tashlaymiz: “as soon as I land”, “before you go”, “until the storm stops”. Uchinchi gapda uchinchi shaxs “-s” ni unutmang: “stops”. To‘rtinchi gap esa to‘g‘ri, chunki bu yerda “when” savol so‘zi. Agar to‘rtinchi gapni ham “tuzatgan” bo‘lsangiz, qoida faqat vaqt ergash gaplariga tegishli ekanini yana bir bor eslang.
scenes.say: One: I'll call you as soon as I land. Two: Before you go, close the door. Three: We'll stay inside until the storm stops. Four is correct: When will the next bus come?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: qo‘nishim bilan sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Ikki: ketishdan oldin eshikni yoping. Uch: bo‘ron to‘xtaguncha ichkarida qolamiz. To‘rtinchisi to‘g‘ri: keyingi avtobus qachon keladi?

scenes.title: Dialog 1: Dam olish kunlari
board: Listen: Malika and Tom
plans for the weekend
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Malika va Tom dam olish kunlari haqida gaplashyapti. Diqqat bilan eshiting: dialogda bugun o‘rgangan deyarli barcha shakllar bor. Kelishuv, jadval, niyat, shu zahoti qilingan taklif va vaqt ergash gapi. Har bir shaklni topishga harakat qiling, keyin savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Tom: What are you doing this weekend, Malika? Malika: I'm visiting my grandparents in Bukhara. The train leaves at eight on Saturday. Tom: Nice! Are you going to stay long? Malika: Just two nights. When I get back, I'm going to start my driving lessons. Tom: Oh, I'll lend you my old theory book, then. Malika: Thanks! I'll text you when I'm home.
scenes.say_uz: Tom: Bu dam olish kunlari nima qilyapsan, Malika? Malika: Buxorodagi buvim va bobomnikiga boryapman. Poyezd shanba kuni soat sakkizda jo‘naydi. Tom: Zo‘r! Uzoq qolmoqchimisan? Malika: Atigi ikki kecha. Qaytib kelganimda haydash darslarini boshlamoqchiman. Tom: Unda senga eski nazariya kitobimni berib turaman. Malika: Rahmat! Uyga kelganimda xabar yozaman.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: savollar
board: 1) When does Malika's train leave?
2) What is she going to do when she gets back?
3) What does Tom offer?
4) Find one arrangement and one instant decision.
scenes.say_native: Savollarga to‘liq gap bilan, ingliz tilida javob bering. To‘rtinchi savol eng qiziq: dialogdan Present Continuous dagi kelishuvni va “will” bilan aytilgan shu zahoti qarorni topib, qaysi so‘zlar ekanini ayting.
scenes.say: One: When does Malika's train leave? Two: What is she going to do when she gets back? Three: What does Tom offer? Four: Find one arrangement and one instant decision.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Malikaning poyezdi qachon jo‘naydi? Ikki: qaytib kelganida nima qilmoqchi? Uch: Tom nima taklif qiladi? To‘rt: bitta kelishuv va bitta shu zahoti qilingan qarorni toping.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) At eight on Saturday.
2) She's going to start driving lessons.
3) His old theory book.
4) I'm visiting... / I'll lend you...
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Poyezd shanba kuni soat sakkizda jo‘naydi, bu jadval, shuning uchun “leaves”. Qaytgach, Malika haydash darslarini boshlamoqchi, bu niyat: “going to”. Tom kitobini taklif qiladi va bu qaror suhbat davomida tug‘ildi: “I’ll lend you.” Yana e’tibor bering: “When I get back” va “when I’m home” — ikkalasida ham vaqt ergash gapi Present Simple da.
scenes.say: One: It leaves at eight on Saturday. Two: She's going to start her driving lessons. Three: He offers to lend her his old theory book. Four: The arrangement is I'm visiting my grandparents. The instant decision is I'll lend you my old theory book.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: shanba kuni soat sakkizda jo‘naydi. Ikki: haydash darslarini boshlamoqchi. Uch: eski nazariya kitobini berib turishni taklif qiladi. To‘rt: kelishuv — buvim va bobomnikiga boryapman. Shu zahoti qaror — eski kitobimni berib turaman.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: Ishdagi qo‘ng‘iroq
board: Listen: a manager and Javlon
a project deadline
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog rasmiyroq. Menejer xodimi Javlon bilan loyiha muddati haqida gaplashyapti. Bu yerda Future Perfect, Future Continuous dagi muloyim so‘roq, vaqt ergash gapi va fikrga asoslangan bashorat bor. Ish muhitida bu shakllar juda ko‘p ishlatiladi, shuning uchun diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say: Manager: Javlon, will the report be ready by Thursday? Javlon: Yes, I'll have finished it by Wednesday evening. Manager: Great. Will you be coming to the meeting on Friday? Javlon: I'm afraid not. This time on Friday I'll be flying to Dubai for the conference. Manager: Of course. Well, as soon as you send the report, I'll check it. Javlon: Perfect. I think the client will be happy with it.
scenes.say_uz: Menejer: Javlon, hisobot payshanbagacha tayyor bo‘ladimi? Javlon: Ha, chorshanba kechqurungacha tugatgan bo‘laman. Menejer: Ajoyib. Juma kungi yig‘ilishga kelasizmi? Javlon: Afsuski, yo‘q. Juma kuni shu vaqtda konferensiya uchun Dubayga uchayotgan bo‘laman. Menejer: Albatta. Hisobotni yuborishingiz bilan tekshiraman. Javlon: Zo‘r. Menimcha, mijozga yoqadi.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: savollar
board: 1) When will Javlon have finished the report?
2) Why can't he come to the meeting?
3) When will the manager check the report?
4) How does Javlon predict the client will feel?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Javob berganda dialogdagi shakllarni ishlating: birinchi savolga Future Perfect bilan, ikkinchisiga Future Continuous bilan javob bering. Uchinchi savolda vaqt ergash gapini to‘g‘ri tuzing.
scenes.say: One: When will Javlon have finished the report? Two: Why can't he come to the meeting? Three: When will the manager check the report? Four: How does Javlon think the client will feel?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Javlon hisobotni qachongacha tugatgan bo‘ladi? Ikki: nega u yig‘ilishga kela olmaydi? Uch: menejer hisobotni qachon tekshiradi? To‘rt: Javlonning fikricha, mijoz o‘zini qanday his qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) By Wednesday evening.
2) He'll be flying to Dubai.
3) As soon as Javlon sends it.
4) He thinks the client will be happy.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Javlon hisobotni chorshanba kechqurungacha tugatgan bo‘ladi, bu natija, shuning uchun “will have finished by”. Juma kuni u uchayotgan bo‘ladi, bu o‘sha paytdagi jarayon. Menejer hisobotni “as soon as you send it” — yuborishingiz bilan tekshiradi, bu yerda “will send” emas. Oxirgi gapda “I think” bilan fikrga asoslangan bashorat: “the client will be happy”.
scenes.say: One: He'll have finished it by Wednesday evening. Two: Because he'll be flying to Dubai for a conference. Three: As soon as Javlon sends it. Four: He thinks the client will be happy with it.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: chorshanba kechqurungacha tugatgan bo‘ladi. Ikki: chunki u konferensiya uchun Dubayga uchayotgan bo‘ladi. Uch: Javlon uni yuborishi bilan. To‘rt: uning fikricha, mijozga yoqadi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: ’ll, won’t, going to
board: I'll /aɪl/ · you'll /juːl/ · it'll /ˈɪtl/
won't /wəʊnt/ ≠ want /wɒnt/
going to → /ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə/ (informal: gonna)
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz haqida. Og‘zaki nutqda “will” deyarli doim qisqa “’ll” bo‘ladi: “I’ll”, “it’ll”, “we’ll”. “Won’t” va “want” ni farqlang: “won’t” da “ou” diftongi, “want” da esa qisqa, ochiq “o” tovushi. Bu farq muhim, chunki ma’no qarama-qarshi. “Going to” dagi “to” kuchsiz shaklda “tə” deb aytiladi. Tez nutqda “gonna” deb eshitasiz, lekin uni rasmiy yozuvda ishlatmang. Va “gonna” faqat “going to” plus fe’l uchun: “I’m going to Paris” ni “gonna Paris” deb bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: I'll call you. It'll be fine. I won't go. I want to go. I'm going to try. In fast, informal speech: I'm gonna try.
scenes.say_uz: Sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Hammasi yaxshi bo‘ladi. Men bormayman. Men bormoqchiman. Harakat qilib ko‘raman. Tez, norasmiy nutqda: I'm gonna try.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
board: I'll call you tonight.
I won't be late. / I want to be early.
It's going to rain. / We'll be waiting.
I'll have finished by six.
scenes.say_native: Diktordan keyin takrorlang. Qisqartmalarni to‘liq aytmang, ya’ni “I will call” emas, “I’ll call” deng. “Won’t” va “want” farqiga e’tibor bering. “I’ll have finished” da “have” ham kuchsiz aytiladi: “I’ll əv finished”. Ritmni ushlashga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: I'll call you tonight. I won't be late. I want to be early. It's going to rain. We'll be waiting for you. I'll have finished by six.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun kechqurun qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Kechikmayman. Erta kelmoqchiman. Yomg‘ir yog‘adi. Sizni kutayotgan bo‘lamiz. Soat oltigacha tugatgan bo‘laman.

scenes.title: Talaffuzni tekshiramiz
board: I'll have finished → /aɪl əv ˈfɪnɪʃt/
won't = /wəʊnt/, want = /wɒnt/
stress: main verbs, not auxiliaries
scenes.say_native: Qanday chiqdi? Ingliz tilida yordamchi fe’llar, ya’ni “will”, “have”, “be”, “to”, odatda urg‘usiz va kuchsiz aytiladi. Urg‘u esa ma’noli so‘zlarga tushadi: asosiy fe’l, ot, vaqt. “I’ll have finished by six” da eng kuchli so‘zlar “finished” va “six”. O‘zbek tilida har bir bo‘g‘inni teng aytishga odatlanganmiz, shuning uchun ingliz ritmini sezish uchun ko‘proq tinglab takrorlang. “Finished” oxiridagi “-ed” bu yerda “t” deb aytiladi.
scenes.say: Listen again: I'll have finished by six. We'll be waiting for you. Notice that the stress falls on finished, six and waiting, not on will, have or be.
scenes.say_uz: Yana tinglang: soat oltigacha tugatgan bo‘laman. Sizni kutayotgan bo‘lamiz. Urg‘u will, have yoki be ga emas, finished, six va waiting ga tushishiga e’tibor bering.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: o‘n yildan keyin
board: In ten years' time, I think I'll...
I'm going to... / By then I'll have...
This time in ten years I'll be...
When I..., I'll...
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. O‘n yildan keyingi hayotingiz haqida bir daqiqa gapiring. Ekrandagi qoliplardan foydalaning: fikrga asoslangan bashorat “will” bilan, niyat “going to” bilan, natija “will have done” bilan, o‘sha paytdagi jarayon “will be doing” bilan va kamida bitta vaqt ergash gapi. Pauza paytida baland ovozda gapiring, xohlasangiz telefoningizga yozib oling.
scenes.say: Now it's your turn. Talk for one minute about your life in ten years. Use at least three different future forms. Start with: In ten years' time...
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. O‘n yildan keyingi hayotingiz haqida bir daqiqa gapiring. Kamida uchta turli kelasi zamon shaklini ishlating. Shunday boshlang: In ten years' time...

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: I'll have graduated · I'll be working
I'm going to buy · When I have kids, I'll...
I think I'll probably...
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. Unda beshta shakl bor: “I’ll have graduated” — natija, “I’ll be working” — o‘sha paytdagi jarayon, “I’m going to buy” — niyat, “When I have children, I’ll teach” — vaqt ergash gapi, “I think I’ll probably travel” — fikrga asoslangan bashorat. O‘z javobingizni namunaga solishtiring. Agar uchta shaklni to‘g‘ri ishlatgan bo‘lsangiz, bugungi maqsadga erishdingiz.
scenes.say: In ten years' time, I'll have graduated and I'll be working as an engineer in Tashkent. I'm going to buy a flat near the centre. When I have children, I'll teach them three languages. I think I'll probably travel a lot, too.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n yildan keyin men universitetni tamomlagan va Toshkentda muhandis bo‘lib ishlayotgan bo‘laman. Markazga yaqin kvartira sotib olmoqchiman. Farzandli bo‘lganimda, ularga uchta til o‘rgataman. Menimcha, ko‘p sayohat ham qilaman.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: will = instant decision, promise, opinion
going to = plan, evidence · Present Cont. = arrangement
Present Simple = timetable · will be -ing / will have V3
when / as soon as + Present (not will)
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. “Will” — shu zahoti qaror, va’da, taklif va fikrga asoslangan bashorat. “Going to” — oldindan qilingan reja va ko‘z oldidagi dalil. Present Continuous — kelishilgan uchrashuv. Present Simple — jadval. “Will be doing” — kelajakdagi paytdagi jarayon, “will have done” — o‘sha paytgacha tugagan natija. “By” va “until” ni farqladik. Va eng muhimi: “when”, “as soon as”, “until” dan keyin “will” ishlatilmaydi.
scenes.say: Great work today! You now know six ways to talk about the future, and you know how to choose between them.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun zo‘r ishladingiz! Endi kelajak haqida gapirishning olti usulini bilasiz va ular orasida tanlay olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Write: My life in 10 years (8–10 sentences)
Use 3+ future forms + 1 time clause
Check: no 'will' after when / as soon as
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. “My life in ten years” mavzusida sakkiz-o‘nta gap yozing yoki bir daqiqalik ovoz yozib oling. Kamida uchta turli kelasi zamon shaklini ishlating va kamida bitta vaqt ergash gapi bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir shakl o‘z ma’nosida ishlatilgan, “when” va “as soon as” dan keyin “will” yo‘q, Future Perfect da uchinchi shakl to‘g‘ri. Keyingi darsda real shart gaplarni, ya’ni “if” bilan haqiqiy shartlarni o‘rganamiz. Ko‘rishguncha!
scenes.say: Your homework: describe your life in ten years. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: o‘n yildan keyingi hayotingizni tasvirlab bering. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: “My life in ten years” mavzusida 8–10 gap yozing yoki bir daqiqalik ovoz yozib oling. Kamida uchta turli kelasi zamon shakli (masalan, will, going to, will be + -ing, will have + V3) va kamida bitta vaqt ergash gapi (when / as soon as / by the time) bo‘lsin. Mezon: har bir shakl o‘z ma’nosida ishlatilgan, when va as soon as dan keyin will yo‘q, Future Perfect da fe’lning uchinchi shakli to‘g‘ri.

quiz.q: A: “The phone's ringing.” B: “___ get it.”
quiz.why_uz: Qaror gapirish paytida qabul qilindi — will: I'll get it.

quiz.q: Look at those black clouds! It ___.
quiz.why_uz: Ko‘z oldidagi dalilga asoslangan bashorat — going to.

quiz.q: I ___ my dentist at 10 tomorrow. I made an appointment last week.
The train to Bukhara ___ at 7.40 tomorrow morning.
quiz.why_uz: Rasmiy jadval — Present Simple: leaves (3-shaxs -s bilan).

options: When I will finish, I'll call you.
When I finish, I'll call you.
When I finish, I call you tomorrow.
When I'll finish, I call you.
quiz.why_uz: Vaqt ergash gapida (when, as soon as) will emas, Present Simple keladi.

quiz.q: This time next week I ___ on a beach in Turkey.
quiz.why_uz: Kelajakdagi paytda davom etayotgan harakat — will be + -ing.
By + kelajakdagi vaqt: o‘sha paytgacha tugagan harakat — will have + V3.

quiz.q: I'll have finished the report ___ Friday.
quiz.why_uz: By — eng kechi bilan o‘sha paytgacha (bir martalik natija). Until — davomli holat uchun.
Inkor gapda probably won't dan oldin keladi.

quiz.q: “What ___ tonight?” — “I'm going to the cinema with Aziz.”
quiz.why_uz: Bugungi rejalar haqida — What are you doing tonight? “What do you do?” kasbni so‘raydi.
